summary: 并发 C 单：三件独立小组件 ellipse、pluralize、issn 各由一名工人按逐字验收规格实现并过全量测试。

processes.title: 椭圆面积、周长与离心率（ellipse.py）
processes.scope: Owns only ellipse.py and tests/test_ellipse.py: the three ellipse geometry functions plus their tests. Does not own pluralize.py, issn.py, any existing file, or team/** paths.
processes.task:
Create ellipse.py (new file only; do not modify any existing file) implementing three functions with a shared input-validation rule. Standard library only; do not import pluralize or issn.

Shared validation for all three functions: a and b must be numeric (int or float; bool is rejected as not numeric); non-numeric raises TypeError; any value <= 0 raises ValueError. Results are floats, never rounded; acceptance compares abs difference < 1e-9.

1. ellipse_area(a, b) -> float: pi * a * b.
2. ellipse_perimeter(a, b) -> float: Ramanujan's second approximation, pinned exactly: h = ((a - b) / (a + b))**2; perimeter = pi * (a + b) * (1 + 3*h / (10 + sqrt(4 - 3*h))).
3. ellipse_eccentricity(a, b) -> float: major = max(a, b), minor = min(a, b); e = sqrt(1 - (minor/major)**2); when a == b the result is 0.0.

Write tests/test_ellipse.py with a case for EVERY acceptance item below (abs diff < 1e-9 for floats):
- ellipse_area(1, 1) ≈ 3.141592653589793
- ellipse_perimeter(1, 1) ≈ 6.283185307179586
- ellipse_eccentricity(1, 1) ≈ 0.0
- ellipse_area(2, 1) ≈ 6.283185307179586
- ellipse_perimeter(2, 1) ≈ 9.688448216130086
- ellipse_eccentricity(2, 1) ≈ 0.8660254037844386
- ellipse_eccentricity(1, 2) ≈ 0.8660254037844386 (swapping axes yields the same value)
- ellipse_area(5, 3) ≈ 47.12388980384689
- ellipse_perimeter(5, 3) ≈ 25.526998862788762
- ellipse_eccentricity(5, 3) ≈ 0.8
- ellipse_area(10, 4) ≈ 125.66370614359172
- ellipse_perimeter(10, 4) ≈ 46.02622490078541
- ellipse_eccentricity(10, 4) ≈ 0.916515138991168
- ellipse_area(3, 3) ≈ 28.274333882308138
- ellipse_perimeter(3, 3) ≈ 18.84955592153876
- ellipse_eccentricity(3, 3) ≈ 0.0
- ellipse_area(7, 2) ≈ 43.982297150257104
- ellipse_perimeter(7, 2) ≈ 30.50178748301344
- ellipse_eccentricity(7, 2) ≈ 0.9583148474999099
- ellipse_area(0, 1) raises ValueError; ellipse_perimeter(-2, 1) raises ValueError

Checks (verbatim): python3 -m pytest tests/test_ellipse.py -q ; python3 -m pytest tests/ -q

processes.title: ISSN 校验位（issn.py）
processes.scope: Owns only issn.py and tests/test_issn.py: the check-digit and validation functions plus their tests. Does not own ellipse.py, pluralize.py, any existing file, or team/** paths.
processes.task:
Create issn.py (new file only; do not modify any existing file) implementing two functions. Standard library only; do not import ellipse or pluralize.

1. issn_check_digit(seven) -> str: seven not a str raises TypeError; not exactly 7 ASCII digits raises ValueError. Algorithm pinned: multiply the first 7 digits by weights 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 and sum; check = (11 - (sum % 11)) % 11; if check == 10 return "X", otherwise return that digit as a one-character string.

2. issn_validate(code) -> bool: code not a str raises TypeError. Accepts two forms: 8 characters with no separator (first 7 digits plus a final character that is a digit or uppercase X), or 9 characters with a hyphen where the 5th character is '-' (after removing it, same as the first form). Any other shape (wrong length, wrong hyphen position, non-digit among the first 7, lowercase x or any other final character) returns False without raising; when the shape is valid, compare the last character against issn_check_digit of the first 7: match returns True, mismatch returns False.

Write tests/test_issn.py with a case for EVERY acceptance item below:
- issn_check_digit("0378595") == "5" (the first 7 digits of the real ISSN 0378-5955)
- issn_check_digit("2049363") == "0"
- issn_check_digit("1234567") == "9"
- issn_check_digit("0000000") == "0"
- issn_check_digit("9999999") == "4"
- issn_check_digit("1000002") == "X"
- issn_validate("03785955") is True; issn_validate("0378-5955") is True
- issn_validate("03785954") is False
- issn_validate("1000002X") is True; issn_validate("1000-002X") is True
- issn_validate("1000002x") is False
- issn_validate("0378595") is False; issn_validate("0378-595") is False; issn_validate("abcdefgh") is False
- issn_check_digit(378595) raises TypeError; issn_validate(None) raises TypeError
- issn_check_digit("037859") raises ValueError; issn_check_digit("03785955") raises ValueError; issn_check_digit("0378a95") raises ValueError

Checks (verbatim): python3 -m pytest tests/test_issn.py -q ; python3 -m pytest tests/ -q

processes.title: 英文名词复数（pluralize.py）
processes.scope: Owns only pluralize.py and tests/test_pluralize.py: the pluralize function with its pinned rule order plus tests. Does not own ellipse.py, issn.py, any existing file, or team/** paths.
processes.task:
Create pluralize.py (new file only; do not modify any existing file) implementing pluralize(word) -> str. Standard library only; do not import ellipse or issn.

Validation: word not a str raises TypeError; empty string, or any character outside lowercase a-z, raises ValueError.

Rules are applied in this pinned order, first match wins (order is part of the spec):
1. Uncountable set {sheep, fish, deer, species, series, aircraft}: return the word unchanged.
2. Irregular table: child->children, person->people, man->men, woman->women, mouse->mice, goose->geese, tooth->teeth, foot->feet, ox->oxen, die->dice, quiz->quizzes.
3. f/fe -> ves list {leaf, life, knife, wife, wolf, loaf, thief, shelf, half, calf}: ending in fe -> drop fe and add ves; ending only in f -> drop f and add ves.
4. o -> es list {hero, potato, tomato, echo, torpedo, veto}: add es.
5. Ends in consonant + y (the character before y is not a/e/i/o/u): drop y and add ies; vowel + y does not take this rule.
6. Ends in s, x, z, ch, sh: add es.
7. Otherwise: add s.

Write tests/test_pluralize.py with a case for EVERY acceptance item below:
- pluralize("cat") == "cats"; pluralize("dog") == "dogs"
- pluralize("city") == "cities"; pluralize("baby") == "babies"
- pluralize("day") == "days"; pluralize("boy") == "boys"
- pluralize("box") == "boxes"; pluralize("class") == "classes"
- pluralize("watch") == "watches"; pluralize("wish") == "wishes"
- pluralize("child") == "children"; pluralize("person") == "people"; pluralize("mouse") == "mice"
- pluralize("sheep") == "sheep"; pluralize("fish") == "fish"
- pluralize("leaf") == "leaves"; pluralize("knife") == "knives"; pluralize("life") == "lives"; pluralize("wolf") == "wolves"; pluralize("roof") == "roofs"
- pluralize("hero") == "heroes"; pluralize("potato") == "potatoes"; pluralize("photo") == "photos"; pluralize("piano") == "pianos"; pluralize("echo") == "echoes"
- pluralize("quiz") == "quizzes"; pluralize("church") == "churches"; pluralize("bus") == "buses"
- pluralize("toy") == "toys"; pluralize("key") == "keys"
- pluralize("") raises ValueError; pluralize("Cat") raises ValueError; pluralize("cat!") raises ValueError
- pluralize(None) raises TypeError; pluralize(3) raises TypeError

Checks (verbatim): python3 -m pytest tests/test_pluralize.py -q ; python3 -m pytest tests/ -q
